lockup.summary: Lycia, its officers, directors and holders of nearly all its shares agreed not to sell for 180 days after the prospectus date, with some exceptions.

what: Lycia is a clinical-stage biotech company developing new medicines for allergic and autoimmune diseases using its LYTAC platform.
risks: Lycia is a young company with no approved products and no completed clinical trials, so it is hard to judge its chances of success.
Lycia has lost a lot of money since it started, has no product sales, and may never become profitable.
If Lycia has trouble enrolling patients in its clinical trials, getting the regulatory approvals it needs could be delayed or blocked.
